FFmpeg - license notice (bundled with BYTEPLUS for Maya)
========================================================

This product bundles "ffmpeg.exe", a build of FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org),
used to transcode Maya playblasts to H.264 MP4 for the Seedance video feature.

LICENSE

License version 2.1 or later (LGPL-2.1-or-later). FFmpeg is free software; you
can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the LGPL as published
by the Free Software Foundation.

FFmpeg is distributed WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty
of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the LGPL for
details. A full copy of the LGPL-2.1 license text is included alongside this
file (LICENSE.txt from the FFmpeg build) and is available at:
    https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html

BUILD / SOURCE
--------------
Bundled build: BtbN FFmpeg-Builds, "win64-lgpl" (static).
  Builds:  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases
The complete corresponding source code for this FFmpeg version is available at:
  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds   (build scripts)
  https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git       (FFmpeg source)
  https://ffmpeg.org/download.html        (release tarballs)
